desc: American women are all different. What makes them the same is their feminine spirit, one that is beautiful inside and out. Henry is proud to have captured that spirit in the Henry American Beauty Rifle. Named after the iconic American Beauty Rose, the main panel features an American Beauty Rose in 14k gold plating embellished with a floral scroll pattern. Beneath the rose is the banner AMERICAN BEAUTY. Hand-cut by master engraver Heidi Roos, the rose and other elements are mechanically transferred onto the nickel plated receiver cover. Like all rifles in the award-winning Golden Boy family, it features a beautiful American walnut stock, fully adjustable rear sight, beaded front sight, octagonal barrel, and the smooth action for which Henrys are known. The buttplate and barrel band are silver. It's drilled and tapped for easy scope mounting. Offered in caliber .22 S/L/LR, capacity is 15 rounds of 22 Long Rifle and as much as 21 rounds of 22 Short.
